result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health is a great place to work


To learn more about our organisation visit monashhealth.org. 



Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.



To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos: monashhealth.org-careers.



Monash Health is Victoria's largest and most comprehensive health service. For more than 170 years, Monash Health and its predecessors have provided safe, high-quality healthcare for people at every life stage. With 25,500 employees, we provide care to south-eastern metropolitan Melbourne and rural Victoria from over 40 locations, via telehealth, within local communities and in people's homes.


We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. At Monash Health we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence and work to our six guiding principles and our five ICare values.



About Monash Doctors 


To help grow your career, there are more than 1,900 Junior and 1,700 Senior Doctors at Monash Health in over 200 medical specialties. We offer unparallel opportunities in Victoria's largest & most clinically diverse teaching health service. 


Consultant Psychiatrist


Monash Health seeks expressions of interest from excellent medical practitioners for its adult mental health services. Monash Health has a consultant led service delivery model, where the consultant is available upfront to lead patient care in every setting of care, supervise juniors and be available for timely escalation of care.


About the Mental Health Program (MHP) at Monash Health


Monash Health is the largest public health service in Victoria, employing over 18,000 people across a range of specialities.


Monash Health MHP is the largest in Victoria, serving nearly 25% of the Victorian population. The MHP runs the largest psychiatric training program in Victoria with nearly 100 trainee registrars and 20 prevocational trainees. Clinical diversity is a hall mark of the services provided by the MHP - with services such as neuropsychiatry, antenatal and perinatal, psycho-oncology, acute and community psychiatry to old age psychiatry - services across the life span. 


About The Role



Consultant Psychiatrist - 2.0 EFT
o MMC Emergency Psychiatric Services
o MMC Consultation Liaison Services
o Clayton Community Mental Health Services (CCT-PARCS-CCU)



The roles are based within Adult Psychiatry unit at Monash Medical Centre, Clayton, Monash Health, providing clinical and medical leadership to a multidisciplinary team of clinicians working with patients and the peer support workforce.


In these positions, the Consultant Psychiatrist will work closely with the patients and their families, managers-team leaders, clinicians, registrars-HMOs-Interns and the peer support workforce to ensure the provision of safe and effective care as well as assist with the efficient management of the relevant units. The Consultant Psychiatrist will also play an integral role in supporting medical, clinical and peer support staff and managing patient journeys in order to optimise timeliness of care and meeting organisational expectations of care (please refer to Monash Health's iCARE values and Strategic Plan). All positions are supported by relevant junior medical staffing.



About You


You are a recent or an experienced Consultant Psychiatrist or a Senior Registrar awaiting Fellowship.



You Are Also 
- committed to a leadership & mentoring role
- dedicated to safe best practice & quality care
- committed to delivering patient centred care & a patient advocacy
- enthusiastic, compassionate & able to work collaboratively
- excited to be accountable for and manage specific portfolios in our relentless pursuit of excellence
- keenly interested in teaching medical students and registrars


What You Need
- Relevant Qualification - Fellowship of the Royal Australian & New Zealand College of Psychiatrists (FRANZCP) or equivalent 
- Desirable for CL role - Advanced Training Certificate (Consultation Liaison Psychiatry)
- Demonstrated experience
- Current AHPRA registration
- Participation in CPD
- Valid WWC certificate
- Valid Driving licence - senior medical staff are required to travel between Monash Health sites should the need arise
- Australian working rights


What We Offer
- access to Monash Health in-house learning portals 
- avenues to further develop your leadership skills
- mentorship 
- support to attend relevant forums & conferences
- a supportive learning environment, should you wish to undertake further training and studies, including a PhD in psychiatric subspecialties in collaboration with Monash University Department of Psychiatry


In addition, you will have access to benefits including salary packaging to increase your take-home pay, access to onsite staff car parking and gym, and the Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Dr Vaidy Swaminathan, Head of Unit, Adult Psychiatry, MMC on 9594 7795.


Position Description can be found here





Our Culture and Values 






At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 







Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 







You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 







We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 







We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 





How to Apply


Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'


Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date. 


Applications close: 14 July, 2026    Click here to Apply now →

COMPANY PROFILE

M10 Truss Pty Ltd is a leading supplier and manufacturer of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames and floor systems servicing residential and commercial construction projects throughout Victoria.

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Building and Engineering Technician to join our team in Melbourne.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will provide technical support across the design, estimating, manufacturing and project coordination functions of the business. The role requires strong knowledge of timber truss and frame construction systems and the ability to interpret engineering and architectural documentation.
RESPONSIBILITIES
•	Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings for timber roof truss, wall frame and floor system projects.
•	Prepare and review technical documentation, production information and material specifications.
•	Conduct material take-offs, quantity assessments and project estimates.
•	Assist in the coordination of manufacturing requirements to ensure products are produced in accordance with approved designs and Australian Standards.
•	Liaise with builders, engineers, contractors, suppliers and internal production teams regarding technical requirements and project specifications.
•	Monitor product quality and compliance throughout manufacturing and installation processes.
•	Identify and resolve technical issues relating to structural building components.
•	Assist with project scheduling, workflow planning and production coordination.
•	Maintain accurate project records, technical documentation and compliance reports.
•	Support continuous improvement initiatives relating to quality, efficiency and workplace safety.
ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
•	Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Engineering, Construction Technology or a related field.
•	Minimum 2 years relevant industry experience in building products, timber truss and frame, construction engineering support, estimating or detailing.
•	Ability to interpret engineering, architectural and construction drawings.
•	Strong technical and analytical skills.
•	Excellent communication and organisational abilities.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry software applications.
Highly Desirable
•	Experience using MiTek, Sapphire, Pryda Build, Multinail or similar truss design software.
•	Experience within prefabricated timber truss and frame manufacturing environments.
•	Knowledge of Australian Building Codes and relevant Australian Standards.
CULTURE & BENEFITS
•	Competitive salary package.
•	Long-term career opportunities.
•	Supportive and collaborative working environment.
•	Ongoing professional development and technical training.

APPLICATIONS

To apply for this position, please click 'Apply for this job'.
